name: lcms_metabolomics_consensus
description: LC-MS metabolomics processing via xcms (peak picking + grouping + retention time correction), camera (isotope and adduct annotation), biosigner (multi-method feature selection: PLS-DA + Random Forest + SVM), and clumsid (clustering of similar fragmentation spectra). The camera_*, biosigner, clumsid family are part of a 43-member alternative-substitution cluster — each step's role can be substituted by another cluster member when the experimental design calls for it.
example_queries: mass spec metabolomics with consensus feature selection
xcms camera biosigner pipeline for metabolomics
